description: Various asynchronous operations with timeout support.
name: timeable-promise

scripts.build: npm run build:docs && npm run build:dist
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:ready && npm run deploy:tag && echo "\033[1;32mnpm publish ./dist --verbose\033[0m"
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run deploy:ready && npm publish --dry-run ./dist --verbose && echo "\033[1;32mgit commit && git push origin && npm run deploy\033[0m" || echo "\033[1;31m$(npm pkg get name | tr -d '"') v$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"') is published. Do you want to bump up the version and modify CHANGELOG?\033[0m"
scripts.deploy:tag: git tag $(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"') && git push --tags
scripts.test: bun run test:deps:ci && bun run test:lint && bun run test:type && bun run test:unit && bun run test:perf && bun run test:leak
scripts.test:deps:ci: bun outdated | grep -vE '\-\-\-|Package|bun' | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]*│[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*│[[:space:]]*/ | /g; s/[[:space:]]*│[[:space:]]*$//'
scripts.test:lint: bun run test:biome && bun run test:eslint
